description: Spec 014 (phase 4c, SRD Annex C §C.11, owner decision 31): the fused tracker, the frozen IMM reference with the frozen T2's range (experiments/20261101-p4b-models) fused in as a log-range measurement (k 4, every 6 samples), judged at G5 unchanged on fresh seed 214 (400,000; its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone). Nothing is trained: the dataset (seed 211) supplies the normalisation for T2's derived features, and the plan pins the fresh test digest that tma-g5 checks.
